subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` ever expose existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace boundary, or should the rail hide/restyle those entries without raw filesystem access?
rationale: The current patch changes a shared operator-read Gateway boundary and security-sensitive file metadata behavior; automation cannot safely choose that product/security contract.

options.title: Keep The Fs-Safe Boundary
options.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and solve the Missing badge with boundary-preserving filtering, neutral external-file state, or directory-aware in-workspace handling.

options.title: Split The UI Fix
options.body: Treat the layout work as already handled by the merged rail overflow fix and continue missing-label work in a refreshed backend/UI-only branch.

options.title: Accept External Metadata
options.body: Allow the list RPC to expose external path metadata only with explicit security acceptance, documented semantics, and targeted tests.

recommendation.title: Keep The Fs-Safe Boundary
recommendation.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and solve the Missing badge with boundary-preserving filtering, neutral external-file state, or directory-aware in-workspace handling.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original workspace rail feature and have adjacent history in the affected Gateway/UI surface.
